PLAN "12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Support muscle hypertrophy with plant-based protein plan"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "GPP to hypertrophy acclimation":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper/Lower volume mix":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          push_up 2x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull split with core":
        warmup:
          rowin g 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          plank 3x30s rpe 3
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Progressive overload and accessory focus":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Back and biceps emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_leg_raise 3x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Legs and core" :
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          butterfly_stretch 1x60s
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Hypertrophy peak and density":
        warmup:
          jogging 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hanging_leg_raise 3x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Push/Pull density":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          side_plank 2x30s per side
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower body and core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x60s
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Final overload phase":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 4
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Accessory and conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1x60s
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Unload and deload-lite":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 1x60s

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots: as shown (e.g., 3x8..12).
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: rpe <number>.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.

NUTRITION_PLAN
  TARGET_PROTEIN_PER_DAY 150g (plant-based)
  NOTES "Daily protein to be sourced from a variety of plant-based proteins (legumes, soy, tempeh, seitan, quinoa, pulses, nuts, seeds, grains). Consider protein timing around workouts (pre/post workout protein) and total daily calories to support muscle gain. Hydration and micronutrient planning advised. Consult with client for any allergies or intolerances."
